title: Arbor tools
description: The tools the setup repo puts on every machine: .agents/tools.json. Sync lists a machine whose tools differ and waits for you to bring it in line; nothing is installed by itself.

installers.description: The installers a machine tries, in order, for a tool it hasn't got. Default: brew, mise, npm on a Mac; mise, brew, npm on Linux.

tools.description: Each tool by the name Sync › Software gives it.

machines.description: A machine's own value, by its name, or every machine with a role as @role.

value.description: latest: the newest its installer has. A version or the start of one (22, 0.9.1). own: the machine's business. removed: taken off.
